description: Search your saved memories (personal notes + user profile). Use it when an answer depends on prior work, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos not already present in the current turn. Full-text search over the memory entries: terms are ANDed, quoted spans match exact phrases, OR broadens, and a plain word also matches longer words starting with it. Returns ranked hits with the excerpt and its source file+line; use memory_get with a hit's target + index to read the rest of a truncated entry. Do not repeat memory retrieval when supplied context fully answers the question. If low confidence after searching, say you checked.
name: memory_search

max_results.description: Max hits to return. Default 5, max 20.

query.description: Keywords, a phrase, or a boolean expression to find in saved memories (e.g. 'deployment checklist', '"release process"', 'deploy OR rollback').

target.description: Which store to search: 'memory' for personal notes, 'user' for user profile, 'all' (default) for both.
